dialogues.speaker: Baron Bigfoot
dialogues.text: Hmm, these potions really are capable of bringing out the Cryo powers of the Fungi.

dialogues.speaker: Baron Bigfoot
dialogues.text: Yeah. When I was younger, I traveled to Mondstadt and loved working in the cold. My peers called me the "Bigfoot."

dialogues.speaker: Baron Bigfoot
dialogues.text: Now that I've joined this competition, it would only be right that I carry on my old habits.

dialogues.speaker: Baron Bigfoot
dialogues.text: And that's why my Fungus team will be centered around Gusto-Frosto to maximize the Cryo effects.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why would you tell us all about your Fungi? What if we get matched against each other?

dialogues.speaker: Baron Bigfoot
dialogues.text: Using extra information to secure victory is a useful tactic, but it's not my style.

dialogues.speaker: Baron Bigfoot
dialogues.text: After all, this is just a competition — not some kind of cutthroat battle. Fairness is very important to me, so it wouldn't make a difference if I told you.

dialogues.speaker: Baron Bigfoot
dialogues.text: Not bad, it's a good place to toughen up.

response.speaker: Baron Bigfoot
response.text: Experiencing hardships together is the way to become stronger with your Fungi.

response.speaker: Baron Bigfoot
response.text: I joined the parties of many adventurers when I was young. We traveled the world and completed a good number of commissions from the association.

response.speaker: Baron Bigfoot
response.text: Having experienced countless dangers and challenges, we became stronger at an unbelievable speed. The same philosophy applies to Fungi as well.

response.speaker: Baron Bigfoot
response.text: The organizers picked a perfect place to train and toughen up the Fungi.

response.speaker: Baron Bigfoot
response.text: We don't know where the enemies here are from... but that's not something we competitors need to know.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, this guy really has it all figured out. Not only is he thorough, he's really passionate as well!

response.speaker: Baron Bigfoot
response.text: It's not a problem at all. We're all competitors here. It's nice to get to know one another.

dialogues.speaker: Baron Bigfoot
dialogues.text: Hey, it's you guys. Thanks for what you did before.

response.speaker: Baron Bigfoot
response.text: You showed me what I was lacking. I still have a lot of training ahead of me.

response.speaker: Baron Bigfoot
response.text: I seem to have been too focused on a single element when it comes to my Fungi. Although your Fungi are also centered around a particular one that's stronger than the rest, your composition is a lot more balanced than mine.

response.speaker: Baron Bigfoot
response.text: In other words, the talent that you guys possess is much more balanced and stable than mine. I still have a lot to learn.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're being too modest! You and Gusto-Frosto are great too!

response.speaker: Baron Bigfoot
response.text: See you around. I hope to chat again soon!

dialogues.speaker: Baron Bigfoot
dialogues.text: Golden Comet, and Silver Companion, congratulations on making it to the finals.

response.speaker: Baron Bigfoot
response.text: After watching your match against Layla, I feel that the two of you have a special bond with the Fungi.

response.speaker: Baron Bigfoot
response.text: You seem to... view the Fungi under the control of the orb... as friends. That's why you're able to understand them better and bring out their full potential.

response.speaker: Baron Bigfoot
response.text: In comparison, I still have the idea that I'm their "master." All I could think of was to train with them to better our techniques. I've failed at giving them the care that they needed.

response.speaker: Baron Bigfoot
response.text: The gap between me and my Fungi is probably the reason I lost to you. I lost, and for good reason.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Please, Brown... erm... Baron Bigfoot! It's not that you were being too hard on your Fungi, it's just that you were treating them in an ordinary way.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Besides, we might actually pick up a thing or two from you. Like going on adventures with the Fungi, or putting ourselves in a dire situation to make our bond a little more... resilient!

response.speaker: Baron Bigfoot
response.text: That's very nice of you to say, Silver Companion! There is no end to honing one's skills. I still have much to learn...

response.speaker: Baron Bigfoot
response.text: Hopefully, after you've claimed the championship, I'll have the honor of going up against you again in the future.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Wait for our good news.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We'll be waiting on yours as well.

choices.text: We need to go and start preparing.

response.speaker: Baron Bigfoot
response.text: Formidable opponents await! You have to keep your eyes peeled. You guys are the best candidates to be champions in my book!
